storyInfo: Natalya rushes about, and with the help of some people, she finds Pavlovich's key backer—Duke Treplev. She attempts to threaten the Duke, leaving him with no choice but to renounce his support for Pavlovich.

attributes.content: '...After that, I went down the list, meeting with each of the students in succession.'
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: 'Unlike Sonya, they were sent to an office by the raion walls to meet with me. Most of them were deeply afraid, too afraid to say anything to me.'
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: I've had enough! Your Honor, how can an imperial hearing tolerate such absurd, vile slander against an innocent noble?
attributes.name: Impatient Noble

attributes.content: His Imperial Majesty personally granted him the title of magistrate for this work. If the truth really is as Natalya described, how could he have earned such distinction?
attributes.name: Impatient Noble

attributes.content: Anyone with ears can tell this 'confession' is actually a denunciation. We cannot be led astray by rumors.
attributes.name: Impatient Noble

attributes.content: As far as I know, the zone still has a—
attributes.name: Impatient Noble

attributes.content: No matter how much you admire Pavlovich's 'managerial skills', my lord, please do not dismiss the suffering in Natalya's testimony as rumor.
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: Just because we're talking inside a warm hall doesn't mean you can deny that there are people outside who are cold and hungry.
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: If we followed your logic, how could Ursus have enjoyed prosperity for the past several centuries while there is so much suffering on Terra?
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: Mind your tongue, Young Zoya. The hearing respects you as the daughter of a martyr, and it is because of this trust and our pursuit of justice that we have asked you here to testify, not to besmirch the nobility!
attributes.name: Impatient Noble

attributes.content: The committee knows I'm protecting a true noble. I won't let anyone casually slander her by dismissing it as a rumor.
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: Preposterous—
attributes.name: Impatient Noble

attributes.content: Order!
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: Young Zoya, your duty is to read the testimony on behalf of Baryshnya Rostova. Only the hearing committee can determine the truth.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: ...I apologize, Your Honor.
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: If the committee only cares about the 'confession', that's the next part.
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: May I continue?
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: Remember, if you again attempt to pass judgment on any noble's views, I will no longer allow you to speak.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: Proceed.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.text: 'When I returned to the city and reported what had happened to the parents, some of them asked me to stay longer, wanting to understand more about their children's circumstances.'
'I had to determine who could offer the most aid, for the chance to relieve the suffering of those within the quarantine zone.'
'And so, I chose a few parents to meet with privately, intentionally embellishing the misery of the students' situation.'
'In the end, I found a noble whose only child had been detained, and he eagerly introduced me to his superior.'

attributes.content: ...And that is what I witnessed in the quarantine zone, Councilor. All of it.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: If we just stand by and watch Pavlovich continue to do as he pleases, especially if we let them keep using heavy weaponry, it won't be long before this turns into an irreversible catastrophe.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Baryshnya Rostova, based on what you have said, you seem to hope the legislature will publicize Pavlovich's crimes, strip him of authority, and perhaps even sack him.
attributes.name: A Certain Councilor

attributes.content: My only wish is to stop him.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Please forgive my directness. I have no intention of casting aspersions on the State Council, nor can I exert any influence upon it, but I can imagine how much resistance such an act will face.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Perhaps we should agree to his demands and postpone the discarding of the quarantined plate, at which point he will release the students as promised.
attributes.name: A Certain Councilor

attributes.content: Do you believe him a man of his word?
attributes.name: A Certain Councilor

attributes.content: No. I have absolutely zero trust in him.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: And I can see that the reason you are asking me such a question is because you cannot trust him either.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Haha, very clever, very clever. Perhaps you and my daughter would get along.
attributes.name: A Certain Councilor

attributes.content: My subordinates also tell me you have not done as he asked since you left the quarantine zone. His request to pressure us parents into retaining Katorga, that is.
attributes.name: A Certain Councilor

attributes.content: Instead, you looked through the list of parents, and after considering our stations, situations, and temperaments, you chose me.
attributes.name: A Certain Councilor

attributes.content: You believe me to be the most politically influential figure you can contact at the moment, one able to grease the right wheels.
attributes.name: A Certain Councilor

attributes.content: Your assessment is correct. I figured you would see through such under-baked schemes with a glance.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: However, it is only because I cannot stop thinking about my friends. They are enduring great torment within Katorga even as we speak. The danger to their lives grows every second that passes.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: I know you have your concerns about my unrealistic ideas.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Which is why I dare not expect Pavlovich to face immediate punishment. But at the very least, we should strive for better treatment of the students, as well as for the removal of heavy weaponry from the area.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: ...I regret to say that the sitting council is most likely unable to grant your requests.
attributes.name: A Certain Councilor

attributes.content: Mr. Pavlovich mentioned to me that he has the support of many noble friends on the State Council.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: I believe you've left out the word 'old'. Or perhaps the military nobility.
attributes.name: A Certain Councilor

attributes.content: To be quite frank with you, the rifts between Ursine noble factions can hardly be called a secret, even to the Bolívarians. You do not need to tiptoe around the subject.
attributes.name: A Certain Councilor

attributes.content: Due to the recent unrest, every resolution, every regulation, who has a sharp tongue in the legislature today, who is praised by the tsar tomorrow... Everything leads to divisions by rank.
attributes.name: A Certain Councilor

attributes.content: If we look at only the State Council, it boasts four hundred or so councilors, most of them from illustrious families, with outstanding achievements of their own.
attributes.name: A Certain Councilor

attributes.content: The hereditary nobles living in the capital, whose family names are recorded in the Almanac of Nobility, number nearly eight hundred.
attributes.name: A Certain Councilor

attributes.content: As for the reputable burghers of influence, they are innumerable. Everyone brings their own complicated stances to the table.
attributes.name: A Certain Councilor

attributes.content: If things were as easy as splitting a blini in two... I do not think Ursus would find herself in this present position.
attributes.name: A Certain Councilor

attributes.content: You mean to tell me...
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: That even some new nobles back Pavlovich. And the reason why we cannot stop him is that he has many powerful supporters.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: This is why I cannot step over everyone's heads to offer you any material assistance on this matter. Not even the Chairman himself could.
attributes.name: A Certain Councilor

attributes.content: To be fortunate enough to speak with you is already the greatest of assistance.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: My objective will not change. If I want to actually save Sonya and all the others in the quarantine zone, I must impede Pavlovich's efforts to the fullest extent of my power.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: An astute assessment, but an assessment is not enough.
attributes.name: A Certain Councilor

attributes.content: When you are young, it is easy to know what you should oppose, but hard to know how to go about doing it.
attributes.name: A Certain Councilor

attributes.content: What will you do, Baryshnya Rostova?
attributes.name: A Certain Councilor

attributes.content: If I can find out why different people are supporting him, and get in touch with a few hidden 'friends'...
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: You reminded me that everyone brings their own complicated stances to the table. If you look at it from another point of view, even the old nobility, even the ones who once called him friend, can shift their stances under the right conditions.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Treating these words as a 'reminder' is rather...
attributes.name: A Certain Councilor

attributes.content: Once this is all over, we must get together again. Once Elotta is done with her things, maybe...
attributes.name: A Certain Councilor

attributes.content: I beg your pardon?
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Nothing.
attributes.name: A Certain Councilor

attributes.content: I have here a piece of information that has spread amongst a portion of the nobility, despite Chairman Witte's attempts to silence it.
attributes.name: A Certain Councilor

attributes.content: His Imperial Majesty has not returned to the palace since the Winter Ball, for some reason.
attributes.name: A Certain Councilor

attributes.content: The Chairman has been quietly dispatching investigators, but none have found any trace of him. After a process of elimination, there is only one place left he could be.
attributes.name: A Certain Councilor

attributes.content: A place that is rather difficult to investigate, at the moment.
attributes.name: A Certain Councilor

attributes.content: Difficult to investigate? Surely you don't mean—
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: His Imperial Majesty might be in the quarantine zone... somewhere even the Chairman cannot search?
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Considering the current state of things, we hope to handle this as quietly as possible, lest greater chaos develop.
attributes.name: A Certain Councilor

attributes.content: As for the nobles who somehow managed to hear of this news, they appear to hope this state of affairs continues. This fits with what you have told me.
attributes.name: A Certain Councilor

attributes.content: ...Some silent stance shifting for an exchange of benefits, or perhaps a wish to relieve the greatest source of pressure from above once and for all.
attributes.name: A Certain Councilor

attributes.content: Not to mention how those who should have been deploying special measures to protect the tsar were slow to react, for some reason, at just the right time.
attributes.name: A Certain Councilor

attributes.content: Which means the precise timeframe of this information is unclear, even though it would not be hard to investigate.
attributes.name: A Certain Councilor

attributes.content: The important thing is, before these special measures take effect, you can continue resolving the problems your friends face, your way. But if they do take effect...
attributes.name: A Certain Councilor

attributes.content: All your friends can do at that point is pray.
attributes.name: A Certain Councilor

attributes.content: ...What exactly are these spe—
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: All you need to know is that, once they are in effect, His Imperial Majesty will return to the palace safely.
attributes.name: A Certain Councilor

attributes.content: However, I do know one more thing that might bring you comfort. Chairman Witte has already suppressed the resolution to abandon the quarantine zone. This should not change for at least a week.
attributes.name: A Certain Councilor

attributes.content: Everything you have said is crucial information for us. On behalf of myself and my friends, we thank you wholeheartedly.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: ...In other words, a councilor divulged to Baryshnya Rostova that some of the new nobility hope His Imperial Majesty will be tortured in the quarantine zone, perhaps even murdered?
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: Though this hearing has approved the omission of names so as to protect the dignity of the nobility, rest assured that we will perform a thorough investigation once it is over.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: No! Who is it?! Who was it who said such a deranged accusation?! I demand the witness tell us the names of these beasts IMMEDIATELY!
attributes.name: Impatient Noble

attributes.content: Drag them out of their lairs! Let us see if their gold-greedy hearts are still made of Ursine flesh!
attributes.name: Impatient Noble

attributes.content: I'm sorry, but I'm not Natalya. I have no idea who the persons mentioned in this letter might be.
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: But based on the following pages, she then called upon many time-honored noble mansions, but their masters were similarly unenthusiastic... You could say that they were unmoved by money.
attributes.name: Absinthe
Impatient Noble
attributes.content: Th-This is ridiculous! I don't care who they are, just say their names, otherwise—

attributes.name: Impatient Noble
attributes.content: Why are you stopping me?

He subconsciously swings his arm, the crisp slap breaking the rare dignity of the hearing once again. All present look his way out of curiosity, as his comrade who stopped him earlier covers the welt with his hand.
Said comrade can only force out a stiff smile in response to everyone's 'concern', but his eyes glare daggers at the impatient, rash noble, who angrily shuts his mouth.
Should I continue? Because someone gave Natalya a list of military nobles, and it's attached to the back of this letter.
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: The letter says that these nobles insist the tsar's disappearance is simply a rumor without even bothering to check, and that some of them wanted to use Natalya to extort the parents of the captured children...
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: Especially on the afternoon of December 29th, when one gentleman who wished not to be named blackmailed her—
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: Wait. You cannot divulge any details about these nobles.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: I will conceal their names as asked, and will not pass judgment on their actions.
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: You cannot mention specific times or places either. Do not feign ignorance of the actual substance of my request. Tell us about this matter, and this matter only, am I clear?!
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: I understand, Your Honor.
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: After that, Natalya did manage to win the support of some parents, but most importantly, she visited the home of an important noble one day.
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: He is a long-time supporter of Pavlovich, and has advocated for using severe punishment to deal with law-breaking students. As long as—
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: ...If you agree with our views, we can reduce the intensity of the fighting in the quarantine zone to a minimum.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Daughter of the House of Rostov... Please leave. If you had not described the situation as critical, I would never have anything to do with a noble of Chernobog.
attributes.name: A Certain Duke

attributes.content: This matter pertains to the tsar's safety, Your Grace. Nobody can bear the guilt of letting Ursus face a national crisis.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: 'National crisis'? You might not know this, girl, but there has been no shortage of madmen shouting these words on the streets of Deity Grypherburg these past few years—I am not referring to you, of course.
attributes.name: A Certain Duke

attributes.content: As for that piece of shocking news you just told me, forgive me, but I must feign ignorance. My mind is incessantly waving a red flag at me, telling me this is simply another piece of theater by those new money upstarts, orchestrated and starring themselves.
attributes.name: A Certain Duke

attributes.content: Perhaps I have misunderstood, but it seems as if you are accusing us of using His Imperial Majesty's safety as a prop piece, uncaring of the consequences if the tsar truly is in danger.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: No, I simply refuse to be coerced by you, even if you are dressed as grandly as your average Grypherburg noble.
attributes.name: A Certain Duke

attributes.content: There is nothing more important these days than giving those youths with poisoned minds a proper education.
attributes.name: A Certain Duke

attributes.content: If, say, at Tsarskoye Selo—at Tsarevgrad, that rabble was not punished severely, what will become of the empire's reputation?
attributes.name: A Certain Duke

attributes.content: Your concern for your peers is understandable, and I will not pry too deeply into what guilt led you to defend that mob. Treat today's meeting as having never happened.
attributes.name: A Certain Duke

attributes.content: ...I understand, Your Grace.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: But believe me when I say that there will come a day that you, too, will defend that 'mob'.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Come again?
attributes.name: A Certain Duke

attributes.content: The reason why I was able to find you was because I heard from a few nobles that you and your heir have been secretly inciting the students to unrest this whole time.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Some have already obtained evidence, evidence that proves Your Grace's cellar is a base for student activities. They even managed to film them rehearsing in your garden.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Hah. A meaningless attempt. No matter how much you bluff and bluster, girl, I will not be fooled.
attributes.name: A Certain Duke

attributes.content: He slowly rises from his seat, no longer looking Natalya in the eye.
I did warn you, if you try and coerce me—
attributes.name: A Certain Duke

attributes.content: Listen to me! Everyone turn about! Retreat!
From what I understand, people guessed the relationship between your heir and the student organization very early on, which even led you to threaten her teachers into quashing these 'rumors'.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: As it so happens, your heir has not made a public appearance since the students who protested at the Winter Ball were arrested.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Because she is busy studying in the Central Governorate—
attributes.name: A Certain Duke

attributes.content: You are free to continue believing your own lies. Perhaps I read too much into things and assumed you and I are in similar positions, able to save her from a doomed future...
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Alas, poor Olga.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Wh-What have you done?!
attributes.name: A Certain Duke

attributes.content: Nothing. Maybe I chanced upon one of their rehearsals here, that's all.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Or perhaps I should say that even unexpected guests such as me can inadvertently stumble onto them in the act. This explains the level of activity within your home, does it not?
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: You—
attributes.name: A Certain Duke

attributes.content: The sunlight is dazzling as it streams in through the window. Rosa lowers her eyes, giving an imperceptible nod before returning to a polite smile befitting a noblewoman.
As I said, I simply heard a few rumors. It is Your Grace's good fortune that they have not spread.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: What do you want?
attributes.name: A Certain Duke

attributes.content: It is not about what I want. It is Your Grace who must protect yourself, and the future of your house.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: It is now just past noon. I hope you will permit me to rest here a while, as I await your answer—
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: No, it was nothing like that!
This is all a lie... Your Honor!
Duke Treplev?
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: I confess, the one Natalya Rostova found was me, and I agreed to reduce arms shipments to Pavlovich.
attributes.name: Duke Treplev

attributes.content: But my daughter is innocent! She was coerced by th-those lunatics in the student organizations!
attributes.name: Duke Treplev

attributes.content: She will testify today, to bravely prove her own innocence, and expose Natalya's lies. She is the next witness.
attributes.name: Duke Treplev

attributes.content: Natalya's letter here is a confession of the dishonesty shown to Your Grace and to others.
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: Ursus has never afforded us opportunity, and yet, not once has Natalya betrayed anyone. She has simply made the right choices, to protect the friends she should protect.
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: No matter who may step up and lie at the witness stand, she is worthy of Ursus, worthy of us.
attributes.name: Absinthe

attributes.content: You—
attributes.name: Duke Treplev

attributes.content: Order!
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: We shall adjourn for a ten-minute recess.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: Have the next witness make ready, parliamentarian.
attributes.name: Arbiter

attributes.content: Countess Vorontsova... I don't understand. This is very much not your style.
attributes.name: Impatient Noble

attributes.content: You clearly have Natalya's true testimony. If you had presented it against Zoya's, the nobles here would not have embarrassed themselves like this, at the very least.
attributes.name: Impatient Noble

attributes.content: You never spoke up once she started narrating her experience in the quarantine zone. Many of our superiors are watching you, and they are angry.
attributes.name: Impatient Noble

attributes.content: What are you waiting for?
attributes.name: Impatient Noble

attributes.content: As you wish.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Good, good. This way, I will have time to explain things to your mother and father. There is still time enough for everything.
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: Oh, such beautiful penmanship, Natashenka. Let me see if you have overlooked anything—
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: Natashenka, you...
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: What is this you've written? Isn't this supposed to be a confession?
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: It is.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: I confess to all those I once cheated and deceived, and to all the suffering students who were, in turn, exploited and abandoned by them.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: They were once my fellow students, even though we did not attend the same school.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: We are all Ursine. We were supposed to all share the same fate.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: No, no!
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: Oh, my child! Who made you bear such suffering? Who branded you a cheat? This was not what I wanted you to do, certainly not!
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: O, bozhe moi, Marsha, what... what must I do to comfort your poor daughter? No more talk of such fearful words, Natashenka! This is not your fault!
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: But there is always someone who must pay the price, or bear the guilt, Countess.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: I have written of these people's participation, describing it as you asked me to, as well as... what stories I know. But you said this is not what I should do.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Have I laid my heart bare incorrectly? Or should I forever keep my distance from responsibility, like a child who never grows up?
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: You shall always be a child to us! I merely wanted to help you, like I would help any friend's family... or my own daughter.
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: But who needs to write such a dour confession for these ridiculous, forgivable mistakes? I do not wish to see you torment yourself so, my... Natashenka...
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: I understand, Countess. I really do.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Your passion and sincerity burn so bright that it often pains me when we are together. But this is not your fault.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: It's just that, after meeting with far too many of noble bearing who were once out of reach, after understanding how they think and how they feel about this country, I can't help but wonder—
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Before the Hippogryph Kingdom had been toppled, when the ancestors of today's Ursine nobility were still common folk, when even Igor Velikiy was just another soldier in the army.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: As the Hippogryphs cracked their whips, they fearlessly threw themselves forward to shield the enslaved. This made everyone believe what flowed in their veins was the blood of honor and courage.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: But if there comes a day the inheritors of such brave blood choose to trample over the oppressed and humiliated, even pick up the whips of the Hippogryphs themselves...
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Will there still be people who believe in them, who want to keep their company?
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: And will I actually take part, and become one of them?
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: This is... our inherent rights—
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: Don't, Natashenka...
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: No, Countess. Please allow me to refuse, just this once.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: If you were to ask me which right I wish everyone would be born with, it would certainly be...
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: 'The right to choose'.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: And right now, it is just like you said... 'There is still time enough for everything'.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: Time enough for me to make my choice, time enough for me to decide what to bear.
attributes.name: Rosa

attributes.content: There is no need.
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: 'Even the most well-crafted of lies cannot withstand the truth you have lived'. Natashenka... has made her choice, nothing more.
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: But she deceived you. At least make her pay the price—
attributes.name: Impatient Noble

attributes.content: I thank your lordship for your enthusiasm. It is just that...
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova

attributes.content: I am somewhat tired.
attributes.name: Countess Vorontsova
